verdict.rationale: Smooth is a cloud browser-automation service, so letting developers attach existing Playwright, Puppeteer or CDP code to its browsers is a fair question. The evidence shows only its own REST API and SDK: natural-language tasks, plus session events such as goto, extract and evaluate_js. Nothing documents a CDP/WebSocket endpoint or any Playwright or Puppeteer connection, and evaluate_js is a related feature that would still mean rewriting code against Smooth's API.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect my existing Playwright, Puppeteer, or CDP automation code to the product's browsers instead of rewriting it
